other_conditions: The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board and have an active membership of the Board.
Financial assistance is available for the first two births of a registered female construction worker or the wife of a registered construction worker.
The application must be made within 12 months after delivery (or up to six months from the date of conception, as per the rules).
A doctor’s certificate approved by a Surgeon/Gynecologist/PHC and, where applicable, a copy of the Mamta card must be submitted with the application.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹6,000 for the wife of a registered construction worker and ₹37,500 for a registered female construction worker for the first two deliveries.
documents_required: Copy of Mamta card (for registered female workers)
